body: Engine struct (BPM, BeatCh chan Beat, StemMix). Tick() for sync beat generation. Run(ctx) for async emission at configured BPM. 4 beat types (Kick/Snare/Bass/Hat) in 4/4 pattern. WorldEffect() maps each type to city effect (sky_pulse/weather_toggle/mob_swing_storm/crowd_ambient). Sine-wave strength curve. Bass on even measures. NewEngine(0)→140 BPM default. 17 tests pass.
title: S120-02: server/beatsync — BeatSync stub service
